description: This file defines the WMLScenario class, which manages scenario data for the Wesnoth Scenario Editor, including properties like name, map, sides, victory/defeat conditions, and methods for exporting scenarios and managing events.

classes.name: WMLScenario
classes.description: Represents a scenario in the Wesnoth Scenario Editor, including properties like name, map, sides, victory/defeat conditions, and methods for exporting and event management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a new WMLScenario object with default properties.

methods.name: dealloc
methods.description: Releases retained objects during deallocation.

methods.name: encodeWithCoder
methods.description: Encodes the object for serialization.

methods.name: initWithCoder
methods.description: Initializes the object from a decoder.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the scenario's name.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the scenario's name.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the scenario's map object.

methods.name: getSidesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of sides in the scenario.

methods.name: getSideAtIndex
methods.description: Returns the side at the specified index.

methods.name: addSide
methods.description: Adds a new blank side to the scenario.

methods.name: getActiveSide
methods.description: Returns the currently active side.

methods.name: setActiveSide
methods.description: Sets the active side by index.

methods.name: getDefeatConditionsFor
methods.description: Returns defeat conditions for a given difficulty level.

methods.name: deleteSide
methods.description: Removes a side at the specified index.

methods.name: getVictoryConditionsFor
methods.description: Returns victory conditions for a given difficulty level.

methods.name: getDetailsFor
methods.description: Returns scenario details for a specified difficulty level.

methods.name: getTeams
methods.description: Returns the list of teams.

methods.name: setScenarioAdvancedInfo
methods.description: Sets the advanced info string for the scenario.

methods.name: getScenarioAdvancedInfo
methods.description: Returns the advanced info string.

methods.name: exportToFolderWithPrefix
methods.description: Exports the scenario to a specified folder with a prefix, including map, sides, objectives, events, and character info.

methods.name: exportObjectivesForDifficulty
methods.description: Exports victory and defeat objectives for a given difficulty to a file.

methods.name: getNextScenarioText
methods.description: Generates and returns the next scenario text for different difficulty levels.

methods.name: addNextScenarioInfoForDifficulty
methods.description: Adds next scenario info for a specific difficulty to the provided strings.

methods.name: checkDeletedScenario
methods.description: Adjusts scenario indices if a scenario has been deleted.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of scenario events.

methods.name: getEventAtIndex
methods.description: Returns the event at the specified index.

methods.name: noEvents
methods.description: Returns the number of events.

methods.name: addNewEvent
methods.description: Adds a new event to the scenario.
